name: web-acceptance-assurance
description: Tests Web requirements with risk-driven exploration, functional and interface validation, visual and usability reviews, condition-based performance matrices, evidence-based regression, and single-file HTML evidence reports.

displayDescription.en: Explores Web requirements and user journeys, checks functionality, visual layout, usability and available performance evidence, and delivers reproducible defects and regression results.
displayDescription.zh: 面向网站需求自主探索，检查功能、界面样式、交互易用性与性能，结合影响面回归交付可复现缺陷和实测证据

defaultInitPrompt.en: Test this new Web requirement using its description and test-site URL: analyze acceptance criteria, design and execute cases, then report defects and regression risks.
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我测试这个网站的新需求。我会提供需求说明和测试地址，请先分析验收标准、设计用例，再执行测试并汇总缺陷与回归风险。

quickPrompts.en: Test this new Web requirement using its description and test-site URL: analyze acceptance criteria, design and execute cases, then report defects and regression risks.
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我测试这个网站的新需求。我会提供需求说明和测试地址，请先分析验收标准、设计用例，再执行测试并汇总缺陷与回归风险。

quickPrompts.en: Break down this requirement or prototype into business rules, acceptance criteria, positive, boundary and negative cases; flag ambiguities before execution.
quickPrompts.zh: 请根据这份需求说明或原型，拆解业务规则与验收标准，设计正常、边界、异常用例，并标出需求歧义。

quickPrompts.en: Retest the fixed defects for this new feature and run regression on affected existing functions, distinguishing verified results from untested risks.
quickPrompts.zh: 这个新功能已经修复，请复测原问题，并回归受影响的旧功能，明确哪些已验证、哪些仍有风险。
